title: Burmese–Siamese War (1765–1767)
text: The Burmese–Siamese War of 1765–1767, also known as the War of the Second Fall of Ayutthaya was the second military conflict between Burma under the Konbaung dynasty and Ayutthaya Kingdom under the Siamese Ban Phlu Luang dynasty that lasted from 1765 until 1767; the war ended the 417-year-old Ayutthaya Kingdom.
